ns.prosjekthotell.056: Discipline code and serial number are set for you. The same document number keeps its whole history.

ns.prosjekthotell.062: The combined model is always the disciplines' current revision. X-ray view and area analysis without installing anything.
ns.prosjekthotell.064: Locked basis from the folders, an anonymous question round and bids on personal links, with no account needed for bidders.
ns.prosjekthotell.066: Check-in under § 15 of the Client Regulations (byggherreforskriften), checklists and deviations on mobile, and an O&M register at handover.

ns.prosjekthotell.073: Drawing packages by email, with a manual log of recipients.
ns.prosjekthotell.074: Nagging about deadlines, one email at a time.
